production_changes: Advanced WPS dialog uses shared confirmation/cancel factory, complete shared theme and shared file icon button.
Existing quick/advanced WPS entry buttons become stop during a WPS task; stopping disables repeated requests; no new buttons.
Only submitted candidate digits from native Trying pin output are shown in progress. Recovered secrets are not status fields.
Reaver is exec-ed as the owned PID and gets SIGINT before existing bounded KILL fallback, as required by its save handler; cancellation does not cancel cleanup itself; cleanup errors are preserved.

Native session files are bound to normalized BSSID and an explicit owned -s path; validated atomic checkpoints are copied locally during existing observation loop and after stop; automatically reloaded on the next run. Invalid/truncated files never replace the last valid local checkpoint.

Initial order file now has the three native state header lines and both native candidate tables instead of the invalid legacy first-table-only file. LF is explicit and local read validation is bounded to 1MiB.
Native early exit, runtime limit, no result and sanitized last observed tool status are included in result messages; the runtime budget remains finite and is not described as exhaustive traversal.
Batch WPS progress now uses outer target index/count and masked label; late updates cannot overwrite stopping state.
Dictionary list accepts multiple local files by drag/drop using existing append/dedup/saving signals; bottom shared resize handle adjusts its height.

Deauth batch setting uses the shared discrete slider plus numeric value; original 1..20 range/default 5 retained; drag commits on release rather than writing every intermediate value; theme/disable/settings paths synchronized.
Main window default width changed from 1280 to 1380; saved geometry logic unchanged.
Router MAC column moved visually after channel; logical indexes, stored widths, privacy controls and sort mapping preserved.

online_feedback.confirmed: First of ten targets succeeded; second switched to native control and failed with TimeoutError after its first submitted candidate; restore phase completed.
online_feedback.not_confirmed: Specific timed-out native request and underlying router/client cause are absent from the submitted diagnostics.
online_feedback.changes: Typed secret-free per-request timeout diagnostics and actionable UI message added; no speculative timeout increase or retry after a submitted candidate. Existing pending-candidate history policy remains unchanged.

limits: No real router/RF verification; native tool integration uses offline fixtures.
Only the latest successfully transferred native checkpoint survives abrupt device/network failure; no guarantee of saving an in-flight attempt.
Submitted online failure is not claimed resolved; new request-level evidence is needed for its root cause.

single_target_timeout_policy.behavior: Only authentication/control response timeouts raised after candidate submission become per-target incomplete results. The owned control context exits before the scheduler catches the typed timeout; the next target forces temporary STA environment preparation. Completed target results are retained.
single_target_timeout_policy.history: An unconfirmed authentication deadline now raises a typed timeout rather than returning False; the pending candidate is not recorded as a rejected password.
single_target_timeout_policy.batch_failures: Cancellation, SSH loss, control-context cleanup failure, backup/configuration/preparation/restore failures remain batch-wide errors.
single_target_timeout_policy.multi_dictionary: A timed-out target is terminal for this batch and is not silently retried in later dictionary rounds.
single_target_timeout_policy.reporting: Per-target messages and final summary count timeout/incomplete results separately from not-found and skipped.
single_target_timeout_policy.limits: Offline verification only. The submitted router-specific control timeout root cause still requires new per-request diagnostics; this change fixes batch isolation, not that underlying cause.
